scope: VXLAN business objects, collection, parsing, Fabric analysis, suggestions, interactive apply and local packaging

mutation.policy: RSpec assertion failures required; unexpected failures rejected

saved_snapshot_review.reference_input: Evidence paths and hashes in the 2026-10-20_03-56-46 reference plan

replay.raw_replay_phase: Verified before the business-object refactor in this audit; parser source files are unchanged in this refactor

public_cli_review.comparison: Full plan.json equality against the pre-refactor CLI using identical input files; source versions are not mixed

performance.basis: local samples, not network latency or a timing gate
performance.review_comparison: Same reference-plan evidence before and after immutable business-object refactor; local single-run samples
performance.address_group_comparison: Earlier parser audit in the same goal; parser files unchanged in the business-object refactor

limits: Saved captures are offline evidence; no new live device collection
Historical configuration backups do not match the saved review capture hashes and cannot certify that batch's raw parser input
No business configuration was sent to real devices; interactive apply was tested with fixtures and local PTY sessions
Typed plan readback requires the before snapshot and checks modeled facts; it does not certify traffic or cross-device transactions
Total storage refusal can prevent invalidating stale summaries; preserve nonzero exit code and recovery-unconfirmed diagnostics

business_objects.acl_policy: Immutable ordered forwarding semantics and resolved address-group members; invalid sequences or unknown dependencies have no policy identity
business_objects.change_plan: Single strict factory with VLAN/VNI, SVI gateway and SVI ACL subtypes; no legacy static execution facade
business_objects.execution: One immutable plan for confirmation, commands and readback; independent before/after configuration snapshots
business_objects.review_reuse: Policies resolved once per role group per invocation; cross-device prerequisites checked before plan construction

review.mode: Local self-review against the pre-refactor source snapshot
review.independent_agent_review: Unavailable because the workspace was out of credits
